paper_topic.reason: Both reviews address source meaning→stated reasoning→observed allocation and distinguish copied labels or existing IDs from supported reasoning. This is descriptive AI-assisted checking of five exploratory conditions, not independent human validation, causal timing evidence, repeated independent trials or investment-performance evidence.

limits: The fresh reviewers were partially masked, not fully blinded; structural source timing and document content can reveal condition information.
This reconciliation had both reviews, mappings and prior findings available and is not an independent blind replication.
Supplied institution packets contain researcher paraphrases and selected excerpts; missing rationale in a packet does not prove absence from the full original document.
Only major semantic findings are reconciled; all original row/claim-level judgments and uncertainties remain authoritative as separate records. Literal binding validity does not establish entailment.
The filename is not evidence that the parent/root personally performed all detailed reading.
